To maximize the total reward in a bandit problem, we must balance exploration (trying arms we know little about) and exploitation (pulling the arm with the highest observed mean). 

Since we have two arms that have not been explored yet ("Lowest Reward" and "Intermediate Reward"), we must sample them to estimate their true mean values, even if the names provided in this scenario seem suggestive. Relying on a single sample of -1.3 from the "Highest Reward" arm is insufficient to determine if it is truly the best choice.

I will start by exploring the "Intermediate Reward" arm.
